subject: Invoice submission: onboarding packet, preferred submission patterns & templates
messages:

Subject: Invoice submission: onboarding packet & template question

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the kickoff yesterday. Our AP team asked me to confirm the preferred invoice submission method before we complete your onboarding packet. We have two questions:

1) Portal vs email fallback: we currently prefer emailing invoices to ap@bluepeak.com. Is Redwood able to accept via your portal only, or do you recommend keeping an email fallback during the first 30 days?

2) Template / PO linking: attached is a sample invoice from our ERP (BluePeak_sample_invoice.csv). Can you confirm the minimal columns you need so we can map our export? Specifically: PO number, PO line, item description, unit price, tax, and remit entity.

Would like to get this clarified so our billing ops can sign off. Happy to jump on a quick 20-min call if helpful.

Thanks,
Sofia Ramos
Head of Finance Operations
BluePeak Solutions

Attachments: BluePeak_sample_invoice.csv

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@bluepeak.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-01T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Invoice submission: onboarding packet & template question

Hi Sofia — thanks for the sample. Short answers up front: portal is preferred, email fallback for the first 30 days is OK, and we can accept a compact CSV with the columns below.

Recommended ingestion approach (production):
- Primary: Redwood Vendor Portal (preferred) — single CSV upload or PDF attachment per invoice.
- Backstop: SMTP to ap-ingest@redwood.com for first 30 days while you complete the portal enrollment.

Minimal CSV columns we require to guarantee PO match:
- po_number (string)
- po_line (optional but recommended)
- invoice_number
- invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD)
- line_description
- quantity
- unit_price
- currency
- tax_amount
- remit_entity

Attached is our compact template: RDW_invoice_template_v1.csv (one row per invoice line). If you prefer single-line invoices, add a line_items_json column with a simple JSON array — but the CSV above is easier to validate.

Next steps:
1) I’ll share the portal invite link and the onboarding form (one-click) — please complete the form so the enablement team can provision your account.
2) If you want, let’s schedule a 20-min mapping call tomorrow to validate field mappings.

Thanks — looping in Markus and Rachel to confirm SLA and PO-stamping expectations.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Vendor Onboarding Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachments: RDW_invoice_template_v1.csv

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@bluepeak.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-02T08:23:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Invoice submission: onboarding packet & template question

Morning — quick procurement note to make sure expectations are clear for go-live:

- PO stamping: Redwood requires the external PO number to be present on the invoice for automated matching. If the PO is missing, the invoice will route to our AP exceptions queue and delay payment.
- Acceptance window: standard payment SLA is net 45 days from invoice_date if PO is present and data validates.
- Subject token convention: for email fallback, please use subject: "BP-4631_invoice_<invoice_number>" so our parser attaches metadata consistently.

Operational asks:
- Please confirm primary remittance entity on the onboarding form (we saw multiple legal entities on your sample).
- If you plan to send multi-line CSVs, indicate whether line_item identifiers are stable across exports.

I’m attaching our short policy doc to illustrate PO-stamp edge cases. Once we have the signed onboarding form we can turn on portal uploads and the email fallback for 30 days.

-Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Procurement, Redwood Inference

Attachments: PO-stamp_policy.pdf
